article.story: HAMILTON, N.Y. -- — Andrew Alekseyenko’s 19 points helped Colgate defeat Utica 109-50 on Wednesday. Alekseyenko also contributed nine rebounds for the Raiders (1-4). Parker Jones scored 17 points and added seven rebounds. Kingston McKoy shot 6 for 8, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 14 points. Prince Kamate led the way for the Pioneers with 16 points. Keyaton Parks added six points and 11 rebounds for Utica. Mathew Simmons finished with six points. Colgate took the lead with 17:42 left in the first half and did not trail again. Alekseyenko led their team in scoring with 15 points in the first half to help put them up 56-16 at the break. Colgate extended its lead to 84-26 during the second half, fueled by a 21-2 scoring run. Jonathan Niv scored a team-high seven points in the second half as their team closed out the win. Up next Colgate hosts Penn State-Behrend in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
